name: Modular Bookcase / Cube Shelf
pitch: Open shelving cut to your wall: adjustable shelves, cube bays, raised for the robot vacuum, with a cleat rail and anti-tip anchor.

stages.title: Cut the sheets
stages.detail: Load sheet 1 on the honeycomb bed, run the fit-test coupon first (slot = tab + 0.1 mm), then cut sheet 1 and sheet 2 from the DXFs (CUT layer). 1 sheet(s), 32 m of cut path; keep the air assist on and the cut order inside-out (holes and slots first).

stages.title: Remove char and sand
stages.detail: Pop parts out, brush the char from the cut edges, 120 then 180 grit on faces and edges; ease the top and shelf corners. Wipe with a damp rag.

stages.title: Dry fit
stages.detail: Stand SIDE-L and SIDE-R, push BOTTOM and MID into their slots, then TOP, then the two rails. Check square, check each tab ends flush with the outside face. No glue yet.

stages.title: Finish the loose parts first
stages.detail: Seal / oil all 3 ADJ-SHELF boards and the inside faces before glue-up (glue will not stick over finish, so mask the tabs and slots).

stages.title: Glue-up (Titebond III)
stages.detail: Lay SIDE-L flat. Glue and tap in BOTTOM, MID, the 1 divider(s), RAIL-BOT and RAIL-TOP, then fit SIDE-R and clamp. Last: seat TOP on all tabs. Wipe squeeze-out at once. Work time about 10 minutes, so do it in two halves if alone.

stages.title: Screw-clamp the joints
stages.detail: 6 #8 screws (3.0 mm pilots are already cut): #8 x 1-1/2 in through each side face into the BOTTOM and MID edges, and down through the TOP into the side edges; countersink and plug the 4 top screws. Square the case while the glue sets.

stages.title: Cleat and anti-tip anchor
stages.detail: Screw the unit half of an aluminum Z-bar (1 in) across the rear face of RAIL-TOP (it sits in the 20 mm rear recess). Mount the wall half level into studs. ALWAYS also fit an anti-tip strap: screw it through one of the two 6 mm holes in RAIL-TOP into a stud. Required on every unit above 900 mm tall.

stages.title: Finish
stages.detail: Two coats of water-based poly or hardwax oil, 180-grit between coats; 24 h to cure before packing.

stages.title: Shelf pins, test, pack
stages.detail: Press in the shelf pins (rows at [928.0, 1152.0, 1376.0] mm above the floor; 23 pin rows available at 32 mm pitch), load-test with 20 kg per shelf, then flat-pack: 1 sheets of parts in one 1.3 x 0.4 x 0.25 m box with corner guards.

materials.sheet: 18 mm (3/4 in) birch or Baltic-birch plywood, 4 x 8 ft (1220 x 2440 mm) x 1

hardware.note: counts from the model; 3.0 mm pilots cut in the parts

hardware.item: Aluminum Z-bar French cleat, 24-36 in pair
hardware.note: optional wall-hang; laser cannot cut the 45 deg bevel

hardware.item: Anti-tip furniture strap kit (ASTM F3096 style)
Wood plugs / filler for top screws

materials.finish: water-based poly or hardwax oil, 2 coats (about $12)

safety: Anchor to a wall stud with an anti-tip strap on every unit (ASTM F3096 style); mandatory above 900 mm.
Not a clothing-storage unit (STURDY Act applies to dressers >= 27 in); not a children's product (no CPSIA testing).
Rated target 20 kg per 800 mm shelf (UNVERIFIED - load test one shelf to 40 kg before selling).
Keep depth >= 0.15 x height; heavy items low.

profit.assumptions: All dollar figures are planning ESTIMATES / ASSUMPTIONS, not quotes, not guaranteed. Sheet prices: 4x8 ft 18 mm birch plywood $70-110, basic plywood $55-75 (assumption). Machine feed 100-200 mm/min is an UNVERIFIED estimate (ACMER publishes no 18 mm ply feed rate). Machine wear/electricity $1.70 per machine-hour (assumption). Labor valued at $25/h for the "after labor" line only. Marketplace fees 10% (assumption, e.g. Etsy-style).
profit.price_band_source: SHORTLIST.md: custom plywood bookcase target $180-$450 (estimate); Etsy plywood bookcases $135-$330; Amazon cube shelf ~$42 [third-party estimates]
profit.note_machine_time: At 100-200 mm/min the laser path alone is 2.7-5.4 machine hours per unit; machine time, not material, is the bottleneck. Verify the real feed on scrap before quoting.
